summary: Explains that removing a collection is done by deleting its installation directory, which varies by system, with examples for the user collections path and a virtualenv's site-packages.
questions: How do I uninstall an Ansible collection?
Is there an ansible-galaxy command to remove a collection?
Where do I delete a collection installed inside a virtualenv?

answer_card.title: Remove a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
Just delete the collection's installation directory. The path depends on where it was installed, for example:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.ansible/collections/ansible_collections/community/general
rm -rf ./venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/ansible_collections/community/general
```
